purpose: Select an original cinematic grammar before legal scripting.
sampling_strategy: Render variant 1 from all six families first. Render variants 2-4 only for a recorded ambiguity, failure, or close contest; deterministic expansion does not trigger a new creative reasoning pass.

families.problem: Find a motivated warm opening whose forward movement feels confident rather than promotional.
Create a complete, clean full-frame occlusion that can hide a stitch without looking like an effect.
Move from apparent freedom into constraint through architecture and lensing, without literal barriers or labels.
Change narrative state inside one space using motivated light rather than a transition effect.
Let foreground and background communicate separation simultaneously in a phone-readable composition.
Find the strongest motion-to-stasis reversal and a precise non-technical myth-break performance.

selection_rule: Choose narrative fitness first, then identity and technical polish. A beautiful but semantically decorative shot is rejected.
reroll_rule: A fifth variant requires a diagnosed failure and either a new declared axis or a child creative seed.
credit_cap_basis: 24 authorized attempts multiplied by the first measured Tier1P5 debit of 10 credits on 2026-08-31. Stop before submission if the live measured debit would exceed this cap.
